title: Harness smoke test (NOT an evaluation)
written_by: AI assistant (same author as the code and the dataset)

queries.text: Overnight every document on the department share got a new extension and nobody can open them. A text file in each folder explains how to pay to get the files back.
Another workstation shows encrypted files and a payment demand. The machine had contacted the same suspicious domain as the earlier cases.
A storage location used by the billing team turned out to be readable from the internet, and access logs show downloads from an address we do not recognise.
The jump server logged thousands of password guesses for the administrator account over a few hours, all from the same remote address.
One of the build machines has been running at full CPU for days. A process with a random name keeps connecting to an outside pool.
The customer website became unreachable for an hour because of a flood of traffic from many addresses at once.
